@graph.name: Freelance Recruiter in India | Work From Home | EarlyJobs

audience.audienceType: Recruiters, HR professionals and career-break returnees

mainEntity.name: What is a freelance recruiter at EarlyJobs?

acceptedAnswer.text: A freelance recruiter works independently on recruitment requirements made available through EarlyJobs, helping identify and engage suitable candidates in line with the agreed process.
The model is designed to offer flexibility in where you work. Specific requirements, communication expectations and deadlines depend on the mandate and programme terms.

mainEntity.name: Can women returning after a career break apply?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Women looking to return to recruitment or explore flexible professional opportunities are welcome to apply, subject to the programme's onboarding and role requirements.

mainEntity.name: Do I need previous recruitment experience?

acceptedAnswer.text: Relevant recruitment or HR experience can be helpful. Applicants without prior experience should confirm the current eligibility criteria and whether an appropriate training or entry-level pathway is available.
Eligible commissions are paid for successful placements according to the applicable mandate and agreed commercial terms. Earnings depend on results and are not guaranteed.
EarlyJobs connects recruiters with available hiring opportunities through its network. Access to specific mandates depends on availability, suitability and the applicable onboarding process.

mainEntity.name: Can I choose my working hours?

acceptedAnswer.text: Freelance recruitment offers greater flexibility than many traditional office roles, but recruiters must still meet agreed deadlines, candidate communication expectations and hiring timelines.
Complete the application form. The team can review your details and share the relevant onboarding process and next steps.
